recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical composition featuring a dense typographic header block on a solid green background and a photographic portrait in the lower two-thirds, characterized by high-contrast condensed lettering and a naturalistic outdoor setting.
coreVisualRelationships: Typographic block occupies the top 40% of the frame
Portrait subject is centered in the lower 60%
Color palette transitions from a saturated artificial green to naturalistic earth tones
Text density creates a rhythmic pattern across the upper horizontal plane
coreInvariants: Horizontal split between solid color and photographic background
Alternating text colors for information hierarchy

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot of a male figure, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and white shirt provide a bright focal point against the green foliage.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down scanning of the dense text block, leading to the central portrait, then down to the bottom-left corner branding.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is filled with either dense text or detailed photographic texture.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Coral orange and sky blue (text highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the top graphic block contrasting with the muted, naturalistic tones of the photograph.

characterSpecificRedesigns: G and S have very tight apertures
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in multiple colors and sizes to distinguish between artist, title, and tracklist.
graphicDevices: Small rectangular badge at the top center
Square logo box in the bottom left corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed verticality of the main titles
Provides the clean, modern-retro sans-serif look for secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen image. The top 40% is a solid forest green rectangle. The bottom 60% is a vintage 1960s-style photograph of a man in a white shirt sitting outdoors with green trees and a pale sky in the background. Add a small square logo box in the bottom left corner.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Using an ultra-condensed bold sans-serif font, fill the top green section with multiple lines of uppercase text. Use coral orange for the primary name and alternating orange and light blue for the list of items below it. Ensure the text is tightly packed and justified.

verificationChecks: Is the top section a solid green block?
Is the font ultra-condensed and uppercase?
Is the subject centered in the lower photographic section?
Are the colors orange and blue used for text highlights?

adjustableVariables: Ratio of text block to photograph
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and track titles

mustAchieve: Clear separation between graphic and photographic elements

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is uppercase and sans-serif
Confirm the vintage photographic grain and tone
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color header + Ultra-condensed justified text + Naturalistic portrait = Mid-century Soul Aesthetic
